# TPC-Havoc Q4_v4

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
select
    priority_group,
    sum(order_count) as order_count
from (
    select
        o_orderpriority as priority_group,
        count(*) as order_count
    from orders
    where o_orderdate >= date '1993-07-01'
      and o_orderdate < date '1993-07-01' + interval '3' month
      and o_orderpriority in ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH')
      and exists (
          select *
          from lineitem
          where l_orderkey = o_orderkey
            and l_commitdate < l_receiptdate
      )
    group by o_orderpriority

    union all

    select
        o_orderpriority as priority_group,
        count(*) as order_count
    from orders
    where o_orderdate >= date '1993-07-01'
      and o_orderdate < date '1993-07-01' + interval '3' month
      and o_orderpriority not in ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH')
      and exists (
          select *
          from lineitem
          where l_orderkey = o_orderkey
            and l_commitdate < l_receiptdate
      )
    group by o_orderpriority
) combined
group by priority_group
order by priority_group
```
